variants.candidate: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Earth sets you solid and slow to shift. Running over, it has no outlet, and you hold peers to your pace or take more than your share. You stay in front with fewer partners each year.
variants.original: Earth is your Body, and running over, it is heaviness accumulating: routines hardened into ruts, comfort eaten past comfort, a body built for staying that now resists moving.

variants.candidate: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Wood builds it upward, stage by stage. As a friction, the rules grow past you, so you serve the demand and the title ahead of your rest. In time you turn the pressure on yourself.
variants.original: Wood is your Order, and as a friction, it is obligations multiplying past your ground: everyone rooted in you, nothing rooted for you, care extracted faster than it regrows. Fall short once and the harshest judgement comes from inside.

variants.candidate: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Water makes it pour and spread as it goes. As a friction, your Action spreads faster than it settles. You chase the next opening ahead of keeping this one, and you lose the savings that staying builds.
variants.original: Water is your Action, and as a friction, it is managing flows you no longer need to manage: accounts checked daily, opportunities tracked past usefulness, control spending the calm it was meant to protect.

variants.candidate: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. What moves you stays, because Fire keeps it warm. As a friction, you keep taking in after you have enough, sheltering an idea or a person rather than testing either. You know far more than you ever tried.
variants.original: Fire is your Mind, and as a friction, it is stimulation mistaken for nourishment: feeds, sparks, novelty consumed all day while real understanding stays shallow. The excitement is spending you, and it feels like input.

variants.candidate: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Metal gives it a hard finish, nothing left half done. As a friction, it takes from what holds you up. You give as much as you try to stand out, and wear yourself down on both.
variants.original: Metal is your Expression, and as a friction, it is output demanded from reserves that fill slowly: more deliverables, more opinions, more polish than your quiet depth can supply. Producing is starting to hollow you.
